verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is a payments platform, so network-token management is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never documents viewing network tokens per card, identifying which wallet or merchant holds a token, or revoking a token independently of the PAN. The only nearby evidence is issuing-side wallet provisioning to Apple Pay and Google Pay, which is an adjacent feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, network tokens are first-class — I can see and manage the tokens created for a card, know which wallet or merchant holds them, and revoke them independently of the PAN
